blocking_failures: behavior_in_tests: The tests cover only a small subset of the instruction. valid_failure_modes: The verifier depends on external network access for apt, curl, and the uv installer, creating failures unrelated to the submitted repair. The tests also omit many specified behaviors, so passing or failing does not reliably reflect the full task requirements.
advice: informative_test_structure: Although the test names are descriptive, the test file is densely compressed into one-line functions and assertions, has no organized sections or explanatory comments, and is difficult to maintain or diagnose.

pinned_dependencies: The Dockerfile uses the floating python:3.13 image and installs unpinned build-essential through apt. The test script pins pytest and uvx tool versions but also downloads the installer and uses an unpinned Python base/runtime context.

instruction_style: The instruction is mostly an engineer-facing request, but its final sentence explicitly describes fresh test scenarios and quantitative test-passing thresholds, which is test-oriented scaffolding rather than solely a required end-state description.
